scope: Real client/loader module and VM Web Crypto path, production wire sizes, synthetic content and stubbed prover calls. No curve/proof/browser-performance claim.
behavior: Trusted schema2 manifest is validated and snapshotted before reads. Whole-verified local derived G1 is preferred; missing/corrupt derived falls back to original fully verified compressed local/CDN input. No derived remote URL is accepted. selectedG1 reports actual format; initialize requires empty derived vs 64-byte-per-point compressed response. Counts/G2/Grumpkin unchanged.
runtimeManifestTrust: Manifest is source-build input, not cache/CDN metadata. Digests are trusted manifest pins; provenance input/G2 hashes must equal original file pins, and gzip WASM path/hash/method/version are fixed. Arbitrary cache metadata objects are rejected as non-byte input.
limitations: Focused tests stub prover API. Actual two-process pinned5.2 WASM experiment is separate crs-experiment-review.md. Integrated generated build and actual browser qualification are pending root integration.
